description: Fable-style spec + evidence gate for Claude Code + Codex. Makes Opus/Codex work under Fable-like discipline: blocks every edit until a deterministic spec passes, and there is no "done" without live acceptance evidence. Spec-first, verification-gated, forbidden-paths enforced.
